task.title: Connect the Modem / ONT
task.shortdesc: Connect the or Optical Network Terminal (ONT) to the Internet service supplied by the Internet Service Provider (ISP).

prereq.p: Make sure that you have the following items:

ul.li: An active Internet service from an ISP
The power adapter for the modem or ONT
The cable or fiber connection supplied by the ISP

prereq.note: The ISP can install and activate the modem or ONT before you start this task.
Do not look into the end of a fiber-optic cable or an optical port. Do not bend, cut, or disconnect a fiber-optic cable. Contact the ISP if the fiber connection requires service.

context.p: The or ONT receives the Internet connection from the ISP. It provides the connection that the uses to access the Internet.
context.note: The location and name of each port can differ by device. Refer to the labels on the modem or ONT.
Confirm that the ISP service is active and that the modem or ONT is registered with the ISP before you connect the router.

step.cmd: Put the or ONT near the ISP service connection and an electrical outlet.

info.p: Make sure that air can move freely around the device. Do not put the device in an enclosed space.

step.cmd: Connect the ISP service cable to the applicable input port on the or ONT.

info.p: Use only the cable and port specified by the ISP.
info.note: If the ISP installed an ONT with a connected fiber cable, do not disconnect the fiber cable.

step.cmd: Connect the supplied power adapter to the or ONT.

info.p: If the device does not have a power button, the device starts when you connect the power adapter.

step.cmd: Wait until the status indicators show that the Internet service is ready.

info.p: The startup process can take several minutes.
info.note: Indicator names, colors, and patterns can differ by device. Refer to the instructions supplied by the ISP.

step.cmd: Connect an Ethernet cable to the on the or ONT.

info.p: Leave the other end of the Ethernet cable available for connection to the on the .

result.p: The or ONT is connected to the ISP service and is ready for connection to the .

postreq.p: Connect the Ethernet cable from the or ONT to the on the .
